title: Member Services Policy: Closing a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Enrollment
content:
**Section 1. Grounds for closing.** A PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment is closed when its activation window lapses, when the underlying service account is final billed, or when a low-balance disconnection has lasted the tier's finaling period (30 calendar days, or 15 on PrePay Power Small Commercial) counted from the disconnection date.

**Section 2. A positive balance at closing.** At closing a remaining prepaid balance of at least the refund check minimum (5.00 on every tier) is refunded by check to the mailing address on file; a smaller positive remainder is moved to the service account's final bill as a transfer to the service account.

**Section 3. A negative balance and unrecovered arrears.** A negative prepaid balance and any unrecovered arrears are billed back on the service account, the arrears as returned arrears and the negative balance as part of the final bill.

**Section 4. No reopening.** A closed prepay account is never reopened; a new enrollment is a new prepay account.

### Balance at closing (hypothetical figures)

| Remaining prepaid balance | Arrears balance | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 12.40 | 0.00 | check for 12.40 to the mailing address on file |
| 5.00 | 0.00 | check for 5.00 |
| 3.10 | 0.00 | 3.10 moved to the final bill |
| -6.25 | 0.00 | 6.25 billed as part of the final bill |
| 8.00 | 140.00 | check for 8.00; 140.00 billed back on the service account as returned arrears |
